title: USS Porter Rescues Divers
description: NORFOLK, Va. - Guided-missile destroyer USS Porter (DDG 78) rescued four scuba divers 40 nautical miles southeast of Wilmington, N.C while participating in Large Scale Exercise (LSE) 2023, Aug. 16, 2023. LSE 2023 is a live, virtual, and constructive, globally integrated exercise designed to refine how the Navy and Marine Corps team synchronizes maritime operations across multiple fleets. Participating units will include six Navy and Marine Corps component commands and seven U.S. numbered Fleets, including U.S. Fleet Cyber Command/U.S. Tenth Fleet, operating across 22 time zones. (U.S. Navy Video by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Manvir Gill)
